subject: Rolljump
text: Rolling as you reach a ledge causes Link to jump slightly farther than normal.

evidence.quote:
Rolljump:  As you come to a ledge if you roll and are rolling when you run 
out of ground you'll jump slightly farther than normal.

subject: Rolljump with Sword
text: Swinging the sword in the air during a roll jump makes Link go slightly farther, but prevents grabbing onto ledges.

evidence.quote:
Rolljump/sword:  Roll jump and swing your sword in the air which will make
you go a little farther with proper timing unfortunately once you've drawn
your sword you wont be able to grab on to a ledge.

subject: Deku Sticks
text: Drawing your sword quickly puts away a burning Deku Stick before it burns out, saving it for attacks that deal double Kokiri Sword damage.

evidence.quote:
Saving deku sticks:  If you have a burning deku stick you can put it away
before it burns out and save it, the quickest way to put it away it so 
draw your sword.  Because let's face it why lose a stick to fire when you 
can lose it by breaking it on the enemy's face (for double the damage of 
the kokiri sword).

subject: Backflip Draw
text: Drawing the sword just after starting a backflip lets Link draw his sword without swinging it.

evidence.quote:
Backflip draw:  A useless/cool looking way to draw your sword while 
backfliping.  Just backflip and draw the sword just after starting the 
flip and Link will pull out his sword without swinging it.

subject: Roll Draw
text: Drawing the sword upon hitting the ground from a fall where you roll allows Link to draw without swinging.

evidence.quote:
Roll draw:  Another useless/cool looking way of drawing the sword.  The 
timing for it is a little harder but if you try to draw your sword as you 
hit the ground from a fall where you'll roll Link will draw his sword 
without swinging it and roll.

subject: Lizalfos
text: Stunning a Lizalfos with a Deku Nut followed by one jump attack with a Deku Stick sends it running.

evidence.quote:
The easiest method is to 
use a deku nut to stun him then one jump attack with a deku stick will send 
him running.

subject: Lizalfos
text: Holding the shield up while Z-targeting until a Lizalfos attacks allows you to jump attack it twice with the Kokiri Sword to drive it away.

evidence.quote:
Just Z-target while holding 
the shield up until they attack.  Once they attack and his your shield jump 
attack them.  After two jump attacks with the kokori sword the one you're 
fighting will run away.

subject: Stalfos
text: Stalfos can be stunned with Deku Nuts while attacking to interrupt their attacks.

evidence.quote:
Because they have a shield you 
can only stun them with deku nuts when they're attacking.  For any attack 
you can stop them at any point by using a deku nut.

subject: Stalfos
text: When fighting a Stalfos as child Link, the Boomerang can travel around its shield and stun it.

evidence.quote:
When you fight the 
stalfos as a kid you have this cool item called the boomerang that can go 
around their shield and stun them.  This simple fact makes the whole battle 
simple.

subject: Iron Knuckle
text: Bait an Iron Knuckle's swing, step back, and jump attack after its axe gets stuck or after its second swing, then backflip away.

evidence.quote:
Just inch close 
enough that they swing and step back out of range of the swing, they'll 
either swing twice or swing once and get the axe stuck in the ground.  If it 
gets stuck immediately jump attack and wait until they pull it out to back 
flip out thus triggering the next attack.  If they swing twice after the 
second swing jump attack them back flip out, because you were in range 
they'll immediately swing again.

subject: Iron Knuckle
text: When an Iron Knuckle's armor breaks off, targeting and shooting it with arrows while running away is a simple tactic.

evidence.quote: The can opener is kinda simple keep attacking, if they get hit durring an attack it'll stop their attack so they litterally won't get a hit in. The stupidly easy method is to target and run back/away as you shoot them with arrows.

subject: Business Scrub
text: A Deku Stick upgrade is sold by the Business Scrub next to the Gossip Stone down the cliff two lefts into the Lost Woods.

evidence.quote:
Go into the  
lost woods and take the first two lefts.  Drop down the cliff and go to the 
business scrub next to the gossip stone.  Buy the Deku stick upgrade and  
head to the great Deku tree.
